packs.name: anomaly-detection
packs.summary: Find unusual rows (fraud, faults, outliers) in tabular data without labels, with Isolation Forest.

recipes.good_for: Unlabelled tabular data where anomalies are rare (< 5%) and look different from normal rows; fast on millions of rows.

packs.name: image-classification
packs.summary: Classify images into categories by fine-tuning a pretrained timm CNN/ViT (folder-per-class data).

recipes.good_for: Product photos, defects, documents, medical-style categories; 50+ images per class; GPU strongly recommended, small models run on CPU.

packs.name: llm-finetune
packs.summary: Fine-tune an open LLM on your instructions/chats with LoRA or QLoRA (4-bit) on one NVIDIA GPU.

recipes.good_for: Teach a 0.5B–8B open model a style, format or domain from 200+ prompt/response pairs; QLoRA fits 7–8B in 8–12 GB VRAM.

packs.name: tabular-classic
packs.summary: Classic machine learning for tabular (CSV) data. CPU only, fast, explainable baselines.

recipes.good_for: First baseline for classification; small-to-medium data; needs explainable coefficients.
Strong default for tabular data; handles non-linearity and mixed feature types with little tuning.

packs.name: text-classification
packs.summary: Classify text (sentiment, intent, topic, spam...) from a CSV with a text column and a label column.

recipes.good_for: First baseline for any language; seconds to train on CPU; strong for topic, spam and keyword-driven labels.
Best accuracy when context matters; 1k+ labelled examples; any language with a multilingual model.

packs.name: timeseries-forecast
packs.summary: Forecast the next values of a numeric time series (sales, demand, load, traffic) with lag features + gradient boosting.

recipes.good_for: One regular series (daily/hourly/weekly) with 100+ points; captures trend-free seasonality and recent momentum.
